title: Do you want a Go Cardano node? Because this is how you get a Go Cardano node!

ms.promise:
Blockchain storage: support for storing and retrieving blocks
Blockchain storage: support for storing and retrieving UTxO's
Blockchain storage: support for storing and retrieving pool & stake registration/de-registration
Blockchain storage: support for storing and retrieving parameter changes
ms.criteria:
All code-related outputs must be completed and implemented according to any specifications in the corresponding GitHub issues (tickets).
All code changes must be reviewed and approved by designated team members before being merged into the main branch.

ms.report:
Go Cardano node, Milestone 1: complete
The blockchain storage has been implemented and support for storing and retrieving blocks, UTxOs, pool and stake registrations, and parameter changes have been established as specified in their corresponding tickets. This is evidenced by the code output, automated testing where applicable, and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 1 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/16/views/1, where Milestone 1 issues can be found and their specifications and code, linked pull requests within each issue, can be examined. All Milestone 1 tickets have been completed and closed. Corresponding usage documentation has been added and can be found here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dingo

ms.report:
Milestone 3: Go Cardano node complete
The Ouroboros node-to-client support has been implemented and support for the LocalTxSubmission, LocalTxMonitor, LocalStateQuery and chainsync mini-protocols have been established, as well as the UTxO RPC API implementation, as specified in their corresponding tickets. Please note for example, the LocalStateQuery issue specifies the limitations of what will be provided, further evidenced by the TODO in code. These limitations are not necessary for transaction building, which is the scope of this funded proposal. The next milestone builds upon this for building and submitting transactions. Issues will be created in the repo for additional functionality to be added at a later date.
This is evidenced by the code output, automated testing where applicable, and code reviews with approvals from a designated team member. All of this can be traced by the GitHub Milestone 3 issues (aka tickets) in our project board, here: https://github.com/orgs/blinklabs-io/projects/16/views/1, where Milestone 3 issues can be found and their specifications and code, linked pull requests within each issue, can be examined. All Milestone 3 tickets have been completed and closed. Corresponding usage documentation has been added and can be found here: https://github.com/blinklabs-io/dingo
